challenges.attack: Transitive module export bypass of direct-parser policy
challenges.expected_behavior: Reject semantic resolution of JSON through imported-module object graphs.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair policy did not treat os.sys as a sys capability.

challenges.attack: Intermediate-directory replacement between resolution and absolute-path open
challenges.expected_behavior: Acquire directories component-by-component through retained parent descriptors.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Replace an intermediate component after resolve and before open.

challenges.attack: lstat/open race while reading offline durable-start accounting artifacts
challenges.expected_behavior: Read all durable-start artifacts relative to one retained root descriptor.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Replace a regular file with a symlink between lstat and read.
